_comment: SINGLE SOURCE OF TRUTH for live squad state. Read by squad_state.py, which optimise_squad.py, build_dashboard.py and fixture_adjust.py all import. TEAM_CHANGE_LOG.md remains the human narrative and the append-only history; this file is the current state that narrative describes. Update BOTH after every actioned transfer.
as_at_note: GW1 pre-deadline. Deadline Fri 21 Aug 2026 17:30 UTC (18:30 BST).

squad.name: Raya
squad.selected_on: 19 clean sheets, best xGC in the league (0.74)

squad.name: Lacroix
squad.selected_on: CBIT 10.8 — clears the 10+ defensive-contribution floor; 11 clean sheets

squad.name: Gabriel
squad.selected_on: xGC 0.72, 18 clean sheets, 23.7 bonus points per 90

squad.name: Virgil
squad.selected_on: xGC 1.25, 10 clean sheets — and the best defensive fixture run in GW1–4 (DEF x 0.69)

squad.name: B.Fernandes
squad.selected_on: xGI/90 0.68 — the highest in the game

squad.name: Schade
squad.selected_on: flat xP 4.55 (before fixtures), delta −1.1, 8 goals — underperforming his chances, so underpriced

squad.name: Mbeumo
squad.selected_on: xGI/90 0.58, delta −3.0 — but on 4 of 5 yellows, so a suspension is one booking away

squad.name: Sarr
squad.selected_on: flat xP 4.78 (before fixtures), xGI/90 0.50, delta −1.1 — only visible once gate 2 moved to a last-16 window

squad.name: João Pedro
squad.selected_on: xGI/90 0.57 — but delta +7.1, meaning he has scored well above his chances. Watch

squad.name: Thiago
squad.selected_on: xGI/90 0.62 and the best availability in the squad — hence the armband

squad.name: Dubravka
squad.selected_on: Goalkeeper cover. Chosen on price, not merit

squad.name: Tavernier
squad.selected_on: First substitute. Below the 75% starts line, so he cannot start — but he is the most valuable autosub in the squad

squad.name: Kayode
squad.selected_on: Bench fodder — price and availability only

squad.name: Shaw
squad.selected_on: Bench fodder. xGI/90 0.08 and it does not matter: merit plays no part in bench picks

bought_for_note: Pre-season, purchase price equals current price for every player. Once the season starts these diverge and FPL pays purchase price plus half any rise on sale — keep bought_for accurate from GW1.

set1.expires_note: GW19 deadline. Chips in set 1 do NOT carry over.

set2.expires_note: Second set unlocks after the set-1 deadline.

selected_on_note: One line per player explaining WHY he is in the squad, mirroring TEAM_CHANGE_LOG.md CURRENT STATE 'Selected on'. Lives here so the dashboard renders the reasoning without parsing prose. Update alongside the log when a player changes.
